query:
INSERT INTO clients (id, org_id, name, currency, created_at, updated_at)
         SELECT gen_random_uuid(), $1, 'Client ' || n, 'EUR',
                '2026-01-01'::timestamptz + n * interval '1 second',
                '2026-01-01'::timestamptz + n * interval '1 second'
         FROM generate_series(1, $2) n
